name: HR_DOR_MASS_REQUESTS
description: This table contains information about the mass requests of the document records.

columns.name: MASS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Primary key. Uniquely identifies a mass request

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: An unique indentifier for the corresponding ESS request

columns.name: SUBMISSION_TIME
columns.description: The time at which the request is submitted.

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: The time at which the submitted request is started.

columns.name: COMPLETED_TIME
columns.description: The time at which the submitted request is completed.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Mass rquest's status like Pending , Completed, Errored etc.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: User-entered comments about this mass request.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: The source system or applications instance which is the source of the collected data.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID
columns.description: An unique indentifier for the system or applications instance which is the source of the collected data.

columns.name: RETRIED
columns.description: Number of retry attempts for the job.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Brief description of the error encountered during job execution.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAILS
columns.description: Detailed information about the error, including stack trace or diagnostic data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
